canada.title: PM Carney takes off Wednesday for summits in Ireland, Philippines, Cambodia and China
canada.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney takes off Wednesday for summits in Asia and Ireland where he’ll look to advance trade and security ties.

canada.title: Jeff Rath sold $6.6M estate amid court fight over First Nation fee refund
canada.summary: Global News examined Rath’s sworn testimony and financial records, uncovering unreported property deals and longstanding debts he sought urgent court approval to pay.

canada.title: The remarkable story behind the secret Canadian guerilla force you've never heard of
canada.summary: It's 1944. Britain's secretive Special Operations Executive decides it wants to build a covert force to send into Japanese-occupied Asia. Needing soldiers who can blend in — with language skills — they ask Chinese Canadians. Despite being originally barred due to racism, about 150 said yes.

canada.title: 'Diluted' and 'muddled': Plan to split Lethbridge into 1 urban, 3 hybrid ridings gets blowback
canada.summary: The Independent Advisory Panel on Electoral Boundaries recommended the expansion of electoral divisions to 91 from 87 for the province's next general election. Under the changes, Lethbridge would have one riding solely made up of roughly 60,000 city residents, as well as three hybrid ridings.

canada.title: New Regina monument honours Polish veterans, those displaced by WW II
canada.summary: Decades after rebuilding their lives in Saskatchewan, Polish survivors are working to ensure those experiences are never forgotten.

canada.title: Wapiti Regional Library closing 6 rural branches in north-central Sask.
canada.summary: The six library branches slated for closure in December are in Alvena, Gronlid, Mistatim, Pilger, Prairie River and St. Benedict.

canada.title: N.W.T. sports review highlights uneven playing field for small communities
canada.summary: A review of the N.W.T.'s participation in large, multisport events has found that many survey respondents believe athletes from outside Yellowknife aren’t getting an equal shot at competing on the big stage.

canada.title: Budget 2026 shifts Liberal government's language on home construction targets
canada.summary: The federal housing minister’s office is reasserting Ottawa’s goal of doubling the pace of home construction — even though references to the Liberals’ hallmark affordability pledge were missing from Budget 2026.

canada.title: What's open, closed around Halifax for Remembrance Day
canada.summary: Under Nova Scotia's Remembrance Day Act, some retail businesses must be closed Nov. 11, including malls, big-box stores and grocery stores.

canada.title: Ukrainian war veteran from Manitoba's Interlake walks the walk in fundraising campaign
canada.summary: Ukrainian war veteran Peter Derksen has completed a nearly six-month and over 4,000 kilometre hike on the Pacific Crest Trail, travelling on foot from the U.S.-Mexico border to Canada as part of a personal fundraising campaign for the ongoing war effort.

canada.title: N.B. veteran to wear replica medals on Remembrance Day after originals were stolen
canada.summary: A 91-year-old New Brunswick veteran thought he might have to spend this Remembrance Day without his medals after his were stolen from his home this summer. But that won't be the case for retired lieutenant-colonel Alan Kennedy. While they aren't the originals, the replicas, made possible because of the effort of a fellow veteran and kindness of a local businesswoman, will be pinned over his heart on Nov. 11.

canada.title: When Moncton was a hub for Allied Forces air crew training
canada.summary: The Moncton servicemen’s centre was established by the Canadian Jewish Congress to provide a welcoming and comfortable space for people of any faith who had been deployed to the area for military training.

canada.title: Website saves Royal Canadian Navy history from being 'buried forever'
canada.summary: Garry Weir's genealogy website began with a small section helping people find military records for loved ones. It has since morphed into a sprawling archive dedicated to Royal Canadian Navy history.

canada.title: Parks Canada to shut down 3 northern warden detachments, centralize in Yellowknife
canada.summary: Kluane National Park and Reserve in Yukon, Nahanni National Park Reserve in N.W.T., and Wood Buffalo National Park in N.W.T. and Alberta will lose their detachments.

canada.title: Film seeks to highlight work documenting French cave Canadian WW I soldiers called home
canada.summary: Last September, men in uniforms dating back to the First World War descended the narrow and slippery steps in the dark to visit Maison Blanche souteraine in northern France. It’s part of a documentary highlighting the work of non-profit Canadigm.

canada.title: Where to find CBC N.L.'s Remembrance Day coverage
canada.summary: Newfoundlanders and Labradorians gather on Wednesday to reflect upon and honour the sacrifices made during the First World War and in subsequent conflicts around the world. CBC N.L. will host a Remembrance Day special, live from the National War Memorial in St. John's.

canada.title: A Christmas care package for a Manitoba WWII soldier was left behind. 80 years later his family is getting it
canada.summary: Descendants of a Second World War soldier from Manitoba are thrilled by the discovery of a Christmas care package hidden for more than 80 years in the attic of an English mansion. The package will soon be returned to the soldier's son, who hopes to put it on display.

canada.title: Montreal to mark Remembrance Day with ceremony
canada.summary: Montrealers looking to pay their respects for Remembrance Day have several options in and around the city on Wednesday.
